---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for NotifyX
title: "[FEATURE]: "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Problem Statement
A clear and concise description of the problem or limitation you are experiencing.
Example: *I'm always frustrated when [...] because [...].*

## Proposed Solution
A clear and concise description of what you want to happen and how you envision the feature working.

## Expected Benefits
Explain why this feature is valuable to NotifyX users and contributors:
- What use case does it solve?
- How does it improve performance, usability, or developer experience?

## Alternative Solutions
A description of any alternative solutions, architectural approaches, or workarounds you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any other context, diagrams, API contract sketches, or references related to the feature request here.
